notes.title: Meet us behind the Pixels
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Let’s take a minute to introduce ourselves as the developers behind the game. This is a great opportunity for us to share a bit about who we are.

We are Simon and Sophie - two enthusiasts working on an indie game. While traveling the world in a motorhome 🚐🏕️, Simon came up with the initial idea for the game and tirelessly 👨‍💻🔥 programs it, Sophie has created the lore and shares content on social media✨. Both contribute to the art-style 🎨 of the game. On our journey, we met, collaborated with and were inspired by very talented musicians, artists and amazing people.

Many thanks to all of you! 🐢


Simon & Sophie

notes.title: 🐢 30-frame Turtle animation in pixel art 🐢
notes.notes:
Our game is inspired by nature, so we decided to use footage of a real turtle swimming underwater.

Let me share some[b] inside footage[/b] of that process...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733515/5c61efacbbf34fd99608988cc20f250f1cd01682.gif[/img]


Here’s how we did it step-by-step:
[list]
[*] Extract 40 frames video footage via ffmpeg
[*] make colored markers on key points of the turtle
[*] stabilize and adjust the image
[*] draw the outlines for your turtle
[*] colorize it 🐢
[/list]


here is the result of this 30 frame animation in pixel art:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733515/3a4d21f63dbf9e11f5b4dbf394ef0fd6ee1b3aa2.gif[/img]

notes.title: 🌟 Introducing Our New Building System 🌟
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the launch of our[b] new building system[/b] for your village.

🏡 Discover Over 300 Unique House Combinations! 🏡

Our new system provides an expansive palette of over [b]300 different combinations of houses[/b]. Whether you prefer cozy tiny hosue or grand mansions, our diverse range ensures you can create the home that the Lumenites needed.

🌼 100+ Cozy Decoration Assets 🌼

But what's a home without its decorations? Dive into our collection of [b]100+ cozy decoration[/b] assets. From hammock, glowing lamps, to to cute garden flowers, each piece is designed to add warmth and character to your village.

💬 We Want to Hear From You! 💬

As we implement new features on high pace, we're eager to get your impression of it. Share it with us on our  [url=https://discord.gg/jTDqZMRR7T]discord[/url].

Thank you for being a part of our journey.
